title: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan: card flavor text

entities.name: Wayta
entities.description: A companion of Ajij who dances across crumbling stones and comments on glimpsing the Core.

entities.name: Ajij
entities.description: A companion who would never let Wayta fall.

entities.name: Yelha
entities.description: An Oltec artisan fond of freshly baked gnomes.

entities.name: Oltec
entities.description: Dinosaur-riding people of the Core who use cosmium and share glyph knowledge with the Malamet.

entities.name: Malamet
entities.description: A people of the Core who allied with the Oltec against the mycoids.

entities.name: Brazen Coalition
entities.description: Pirates united to plunder the underground bounty.

entities.name: Chimil
entities.description: The Oltec sun deity whose light is a warming, healing presence and who gave the Oltec life.

entities.name: Okinec Ahau
entities.description: A Sovereign of the Malamet whose hungry eyes look upward at surface empires.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: A character who knows ancient glyphs and ventured underground; a friend of Akal and Saheeli.

entities.name: Akal Pakal
entities.description: First Steward of Oteclan who defends the Core against intruders.

entities.name: Deep Gods
entities.description: Gods who sealed the Core and watch over the caverns.

entities.name: Itzmin
entities.description: A character who survived a collapse with a new friend.

entities.name: Ihio
entities.description: An Oteclan market vendor.

entities.name: Ojer Taq

entities.name: Anim Pakal
entities.description: Supreme commander of the Thousand Moons.

entities.name: Legion of Dusk

events.summary: Brazen Coalition explorers find the Oltec unimpressed by cannons.
events.quote: To their dismay, Brazen Coalition explorers soon found that the Oltec were not impressed by cannons.

events.summary: The Malamet and Oltec find a common enemy in the mycoids and begin sharing glyph knowledge.
events.quote: the Malamet and the Oltec found a common enemy in the mycoids.

events.summary: Huatli tells Akal that their peoples are cousins still.
events.quote: Our peoples have too long been parted, and yet we are cousins still.

events.summary: The Deep Gods seal the Core and set angels to guard its golden gates.
events.quote: The Core was sealed long ago by the Deep Gods

events.summary: Caparocti kills Clavileño with a spear through the heart.
events.quote: his spear pierced cleanly through Clavileño's tainted heart.

events.summary: Aclazotz plunges the Core into darkness by closing dark shards around Chimil.
events.quote: Aclazotz laughed as the dark shards closed around Chimil, plunging the Core into unnatural darkness.

events.summary: Vito spills innocent blood to open a gateway.
events.quote: The gateway could be opened only by the spilling of innocent blood. Vito did not hesitate.

events.summary: Quintorius and Huatli open the Orazca puzzle-door to the underground world.
events.quote: the door to the underground world rumbled open.

events.summary: Huatli strikes down Vito, vowing Inti will be remembered while he is forgotten.
events.quote: Inti's name will grace our poems and histories for generations. Yours will collect dust, forgotten, in this cave.

events.summary: Quintorius touches an old poncho and Abuelo steps forth as an Echo.
events.quote: A rush of magic condensed into an Echo, and wise Abuelo stepped forth.

events.summary: Saheeli bolsters the Sun Empire's defenses while Huatli ventures underground.
events.quote: While Huatli ventured underground, Saheeli used her unique expertise to bolster the Sun Empire's defenses.

events.summary: Oltec sealed the Core off from the world under siege from the Mycotyrant, until Huatli's party arrived.
events.quote: Centuries ago, under siege from the Mycotyrant, the Oltec sealed the Core off from the world... until Huatli's party arrived.

events.summary: Oltec citizens rally to the Thousand Moons as the Legion of Dusk closes in.
events.quote: As the Legion of Dusk closed in, Oltec citizens rallied to support the Thousand Moons and drive off the invaders.

relations.quote: Dusk Legion invaders sought lone Oltec travelers to prey upon.
